subject: website
name: .env Pledge
summary: Cyfrin Updraft's .env Pledge page. Its source is public (MIT). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it reads the pledge count from an Optimism RPC endpoint without a light client, and its bundled wallet library calls WalletConnect.

connections.name: Optimism RPC (mainnet.optimism.io)
connections.note: Read when the page opens, without a light client.

connections.name: WalletConnect/Reown (api.web3modal.org, pulse.walletconnect.org)
connections.note: Requests from the bundled wallet library, before any wallet is connected.
